page.layout: One printed page. Running heading at top (ornament band above title "LECTORI BENEVOLO S."). Main text in one column, with a decorated initial. Marginal notes in the right margin, beside the text. A line ending at the foot of the text ("Hierosolymita-") continues at the bottom with a catchword-like fragment "(:) 2 num" below the text.

main_text.head: LECTORI BENEVOLO S.
main_text.p: NTER septem Mundi miracula, Templum Ephesium recensetur, Dianæ fictitiæ Deæ dicatum, postquam annis supra ducentos vicenis, à totâ Asiâ, incredibili sumtu extructum esset. Tem-pla duo infignia. Ephes. Plin. l. 36. c. 14

Ego verò, nec structuræ magnificentiâ, nec summâ impensarum moveor, quò minùs inter omnia Templa alia, primas, & merito quidem, ei attribuam, quod non gentilium diis, commentitiis illis, sed Deo vero Opt. Max. Salomon (at quâtus Rex!) Hierosolymis, tum elegantiâ & splendore operis, tum sumtu stupendo ita exstruxit & instruxit, ut omnib. admirationi esset, nec facilè, opinor, inventus fuerit, qui mirabilem istam machinam absque stupore contemplaretur. Sabæi monumentum. 1. Reg. 6.

Sia. cum utroq; Templum, qp nunc produco, Jesuiticum, conferre libeat: Deum immortale, quam illi quidem similimum, & ex omni penè parte respondere, at ab hoc plane esse diversum, deprehendetur! Jesuitic. eū, colla-tum

page.notes: Marginal notes in the right margin are partly damaged and abbreviated; readings such as "Tem-pla", "Ephes.", "Sabæi", "Jesuitic." and "colla-tum" are doubtful. The decorated initial "N" of "NTER" is shown as printed. Last line is partly obscured; the words after "Hierosolymita-" are illegible in the scan and the catchword-like fragment is uncertain.
